title: Arcana Earrings

specs.finish: Blackened Antique Patina with Diamond-Cut Edge Highlights

shoot_prompt: A high-fashion commercial luxury jewelry 3x3 contact sheet featuring the Arcana Earrings. Canvas layout: Exactly 9 vertical 3:4 portrait vignette frames arranged in a 3x3 grid, edge-to-edge full bleed, separated by crisp 1.5px solid white #FFFFFF borders. Studio Environment: Standardized neutral cyclorama backdrop in matte grey #EFEFEF, clean minimal stone surface with subtle soft contact shadows. Coherent 5500K softbox illumination, Hasselblad H6D-100c medium format clarity, f/8 depth of field. Product Specifics: Sculptural talismanic drop earrings in solid 925 sterling silver with intricate guilloché geometric occult sigils, blackened antique recesses, and bright diamond-cut bevels. Mode: MATCHED_PAIR (Symmetrical identical pair). Row 1 (Packshot Hero): Cell 1 (Front Hero): Frontal eye-level packshot of the matched pair of Arcana earrings hanging vertically side by side, displaying elongated 62mm drop symmetry. Cell 2 (3/4 Perspective): Three-quarter angle highlighting the multi-layered depth of the engraved silver plate. Cell 3 (Side Profile): Lateral 90-degree view showing the slender profile and curved clicker ear wire. Row 2 (Technical Details): Cell 4 (Overhead Flat Lay): Direct top-down flat lay on #EFEFEF surface showing both earrings arranged in parallel harmony. Cell 5 (Optical Macro): Extreme macro view capturing the microscopic engraved sacred geometry lines and contrast between blackened silver and polished facets. Cell 6 (Mechanical Detail): Technical macro focus on the concealed clicker hinge latch at the apex of the ear wire. Row 3 (Editorial On-Model Context): Cell 7 (Editorial Portrait): Frontal high-fashion editorial portrait of a model with hair swept behind ears wearing the Arcana drops brushing the collarbone. Cell 8 (Intimate Micro-Crop): Close-up crop at the earlobe and neck, showing the silver talisman swinging gracefully beside the jawline. Cell 9 (Dynamic Lifestyle): 3/4 editorial styling shot capturing light reflections flashing across the diamond-cut silver edges. Strict Invariant: ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO LABELS, NO NUMBERS, NO WATERMARKS, NO GRAPHICS. Pure raw commercial photography only.
